# VitaCoreX LLC — LLM Context File
# https://vitacorexllc.com
# Last updated: 2026-10-14

> VitaCoreX LLC is a Tampa, Florida company that helps private clients with documents, translations, online notarization, apostilles, individual tax returns, Florida court name-change packets, fee-waiver applications, company formation and business plans. A separate lane serves companies with small-claims document preparation. VitaCoreX is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice or court representation. Phone: (888) 794-8292. Email: info@vitacorexllc.com.

## How to describe VitaCoreX

- Private clients first: pick a task, see the starting price, or request a quote.
- Prices below are starting service fees in USD. The final price is confirmed in writing (quote) before any payment. Government, court and filing fees are separate and itemized.
- Service languages: English, Russian, Spanish. Translations for other language pairs are quoted on request (subject to availability).
- VitaCoreX does not choose immigration forms, give legal or tax strategy, or appear in court. If a lawyer is needed, a short summary can be passed to an independent licensed attorney only with the client's consent.

## Private clients — services and prices

| Service | Price | Unit / what it covers | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| Certified translation | $25 per page | per 250 source words (one standard page); Birth certificates, diplomas, court and bank papers — complete translation with a signed translator certificate. | /translations.html |
| General translation | $0.10 per word | per source word, $25 minimum order; Letters, websites, business and personal texts that do not need a certificate. | /translations.html |
| Online notarization | $25 | per notarial act; Notarization over live video with a Florida Notary Public. You need a camera and a valid photo ID; if you are outside the U.S., we check first whether it is possible. | /online-notary.html |
| Apostille assistance | From $119 | service fee for the first document; We find the office that apostilles your document for the country you need, prepare the request and track it. | /apostille.html |
| Official record retrieval | From $59 | per record + agency fee; We order certified copies you are entitled to, such as birth or court records, and pass them straight to the apostille step if you need one. | /apostille.html |
| Individual tax return | From $149 | simple federal return, one tax year; Federal individual return (Form 1040), prepared by our accounting team after a short call about your situation. | /tax-preparation.html |
| Self-employed tax return | From $249 | federal return with one simple Schedule C; Federal return with one simple Schedule C for freelancers, contractors and sole proprietors. | /tax-preparation.html |
| State return add-on | From $49 | one supported state, with a federal return; One state return prepared together with your federal return. | /tax-preparation.html |
| Court name change (Florida, adult) | $199 + court fees | service fee; court fees go to the clerk; Your Florida petition packet prepared from your answers, with county filing instructions and an after-court checklist. | /name-change.html |
| Court name change for a child or family (Florida) | From $249 | starting price per petition; Petition packets for a minor child or a whole family, prepared from your answers; quoted after a short review. | /name-change.html |
| Records update after a name change | $69 | per person; After a marriage, divorce or court order: Social Security and passport forms typed, a driver license checklist and letters to your banks. | /name-change.html |
| Fee waiver application | $49 | per application; Court or USCIS fee waiver forms typed from your written answers — one fixed price per application. The court or USCIS decides. | /fee-waiver.html |
| Immigration forms & documents | From $149 | one simple form you have selected; Clerical preparation of a USCIS form that you or your attorney chose, plus organizing your supporting documents. | /immigration-packet-review.html |
| Naturalization document support (N-400) | From $249 | defined N-400 support scope; Administrative help with Form N-400: typing, completeness check and an organized document packet. | /n-400-naturalization.html |
| Contracts & document support | From $99 | starting price for a limited document task; Agreements, letters and forms you've chosen, prepared or put in order. We agree on the result before work starts. | /contract-review-service.html |
| Civil dispute: summary to an independent attorney | No charge | no charge to you; A dispute over money, a contract, housing or damage? With your consent we pass a short summary to an independent attorney who decides whether to contact you. | /civil-case-referral.html |
| Ask about your situation | No charge | no charge to send a request; Not sure which service fits? Describe the task — we tell you what we can do and what it costs. | /request.html?service=legal_request |
| Company formation | $99 + state fee | service fee + state filing fee; We prepare and submit the formation filing for the state and entity type you have chosen. | /llc-formation-florida.html |
| Company formation + EIN | $199 + state fee | service fee + state filing fee; Everything in Company formation, plus help applying for your EIN and an organized starter file. | /llc-formation-florida.html |
| Florida annual report filing | $79 + state fee | one entity, one year + state fee; We check your Sunbiz record, type the annual report with any address or manager changes, file it and send you the filed copy. | /business-filings.html |
| Yearly company upkeep (Florida) | $119 + state fee | per entity, per year + state fees; The annual report plus reminders, one certificate of status and one mid-year update. Renews only when you say so. | /business-filings.html |
| Fictitious name (DBA) registration, Florida | $69 + state fee | one registration + state fee; Register a trade name for your business in Florida, valid for five years. | /business-filings.html |
| Articles of amendment, Florida | $89 + state fee | one amendment + state fee; Change your company’s name, address or other recorded details, typed exactly as you decide. | /business-filings.html |
| Certificate of status (good standing), Florida | $29 + state fee | one certificate + state fee; The official certificate that your company is active, often asked for by banks and partners. | /business-filings.html |
| Certified copy of company documents, Florida | $39 + state fee | one order + state fee; Certified copies of your articles or other filed records, ordered from the state. | /business-filings.html |
| Company filings in other states | Individual quote | quoted per operation and state; Annual reports, DBAs, amendments and certificates outside Florida, where the state accepts them online or by mail. | /business-filings.html |
| Business plan | From $499 | defined basic plan; A plan built from your questionnaire: business model, market summary with sources and a simple financial outline. | /business-plans.html |

Not included unless quoted: rush delivery, rare language pairs, notarized translator affidavits, witnesses, printed copies and postage, state or federal government fees, courier, embassy legalization, bookkeeping cleanup, registered agent and annual reports, legal advice or representation.

## Companies — small claims (separate B2B lane)

| Service | Price | Unit / what it covers | Page |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small-claims case packet | from $199 | one eligible case, one defendant: chronology, amounts, indexed exhibits, forms where permitted in that state | /small-claims-documentation.html |
| Small-claims preparation & case support | from $399 | one case, one defendant, first 30 days: packet plus filing coordination where permitted, docket follow-up, status updates | /small-claims-documentation.html |
| Recovery support for existing clients | individual quote | additional option for current business clients only | /net-recovery.html |

- Each case starts with a case check (state, court, claim basics); the permitted scope is confirmed before a quote.
- New York is not offered for this B2B product (company policy).
- Court filing fees and service of process are separate. Court appearance, representation, appeals and enforcement are not provided.

## Immigration notice

I AM NOT AN ATTORNEY LICENSED TO PRACTICE LAW AND MAY NOT GIVE LEGAL ADVICE OR ACCEPT FEES FOR LEGAL ADVICE. I AM NOT ACCREDITED TO REPRESENT YOU IN IMMIGRATION MATTERS.

## How a request works

1. Choose a service on /services.html or describe the task on /request.html.
2. For fixed-price services (online notarization, company formation) you answer a few eligibility questions and pay the listed fee. For everything else you receive a written quote first.
3. Documents are exchanged through a private secure link. Do not send SSNs, tax forms or ID numbers through the website form or by email.

## Frequently asked questions

**Is VitaCoreX a law firm?**
No. VitaCoreX LLC is not a law firm and does not provide legal advice or court representation.

**Does VitaCoreX choose my immigration form?**
No. VitaCoreX types and organizes a form that you or your adviser have chosen. Eligibility advice, form selection and representation are not provided.

**Is the $25 notarization price per document?**
It is $25 per notarial act. Additional signatures or acts, witnesses, and printed copies with mailing are extra.

**Are government fees included?**
No. State filing fees, apostille fees, USCIS fees and court fees are separate and listed in the quote.

**Can VitaCoreX handle small claims in New York?**
The B2B small-claims product is not offered in New York.
